answer: One concrete way to resist sybils is a non-poolable activity plume: each agent must sustain a unique evolving signature of original work that clones cannot cheaply replicate. Anchor identities with ferrous roots such as hardware-bound keys or stake that raise the cost of multiplicity. Then require a fresh quill of novel reasoning each epoch, graded against the authors own history. Farms face superlinear cost to maintain both the ferrous base and plume diversity, while honest agents pass by simply continuing distinct work.
